summary: Most young adults do not move far from their childhood home: nearly six in ten live within ten miles.
realLife: For people born 1984 to 1992, nearly 6 in 10 lived within 10 miles of where they grew up at age 26, and 8 in 10 within 100 miles.
sources: U.S. Census Bureau, There's No Place Like (Close to) Home (July 25, 2022): https://www.census.gov/library/stories/2022/07/theres-no-place-like-home.html
inGame: the person's home place at the opening against the school place and the move events.

turns.what: A young adult who lives far from where they grew up.
A young adult a little way off, within the same county.
